title: Roof Maintenance in Portland, OR
roofType: Asphalt shingle with a low-slope section
summary: In October 2024, French Roofing did a maintenance visit on a shingle roof in Portland, OR. The crew cleaned and treated the roof, cleared the moss, re-caulked and re-sealed the chimney and flashings, and cleaned out all the gutters, then issued a 5-year roof certification.
scope: Cleaned the roof and cleared the moss
Re-caulked and re-sealed the chimney and flashings
body: Before the visit, moss had settled into the hip lines and the gutters were full of leaves and debris. The photos show the moss treatment going down, the fresh sealant on the chimney, and the gutters cleaned out.
